title: ORIX USA’s Digital Infrastructure Group Provides Senior Secured Financing to Leading Regional Fiber Platform
summary: ORIX USA’s Digital Infrastructure Group (“ODI”) is pleased to announce its participation as a co-lender in a $1.6 billion senior secured credit facil
body_markdown:
ORIX USA’s[Digital Infrastructure Group](https://www.orix.com/private-credit/digital-infrastructure/) (“ODI”) is pleased to announce its participation as a co-lender in a $1.6 billion senior secured credit facility for a leading U.S. regional fiber platform backed by a communications-focused infrastructure investment manager.


The financing supports the combination of two established regional communications providers and provides flexible capital for continued network investment, integration, and strategic growth. The combined company operates an extensive fiber network across the Central United States and serves a diversified customer base across residential, commercial, wholesale, and public-sector markets.


Reliable fiber connectivity is increasingly critical as rising data consumption and bandwidth-intensive applications drive demand for faster and more resilient communications infrastructure. This transaction reflects ODI’s continued commitment to financing fiber platforms that expand high-speed connectivity across the United States.
